(Currently Amended) A method of selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer, __wherein the information is added by a media request broker that analyzes load information and network conditions__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by the media request broker based on the analyzed load information and network conditions__.
